title: Purported Deepfakes of Public Figures and Celebrities Reportedly Used to Market Honey-Based Supplements as Alzheimer's Treatments

behaviors.text: Beginning around October 2025, a campaign reportedly used AI-generated videos and cloned voices of well-known public figures and celebrities such as a person, a person, a person, a person, and others to market honey-based supplements as treatments for Alzheimer's disease and dementia.
